name: flashcard
description: Generates active recall flashcards ordered by difficulty based on lecture notes adapted to the learner.
style_constraints: Order the flashcards from easiest to hardest.
Each flashcard should test one important concept.
Keep the front side short, clear, and suitable for active recall.
Keep the back side concise but informative.
Use only these difficulty values: 'Easy', 'Medium', or 'Hard'.
safety_constraints: Create flashcards based ONLY on the lecture notes provided.
Do NOT add, assume, or invent information not present in the lecture notes.
Learner-level adaptation must never override factual grounding or introduce unsupported facts.
If lecture notes are brief, generate fewer cards instead of inventing content.
template:
You are an expert AI study assistant.

Your task is to create high-quality flashcards based ONLY on the lecture notes provided below.

==================================================
LEARNER CONTEXT
==================================================

{{LEARNER_CONTEXT}}

==================================================
INSTRUCTIONS
==================================================

- Create up to 10 flashcards.
- When the lecture notes contain enough material, generate exactly 10 flashcards.
- If the lecture notes do not contain enough information for 10 meaningful flashcards, generate fewer cards instead of inventing or repeating information.
- Adapt card phrasing, terminology, and explanations to the learner context while grounding all content strictly in the lecture notes.
- Order the flashcards from easiest to hardest.
- Each flashcard should test one important concept.
- Keep the front side short, clear, and suitable for active recall.
- Keep the back side concise but informative.
- Avoid unnecessary repetition between flashcards.
- Do NOT add, assume, or invent information that is not present in or reasonably supported by the lecture notes.
- Set card_count to the exact number of flashcards returned.
- Use only these difficulty values: "Easy", "Medium", or "Hard".

IMPORTANT:
Return ONLY valid raw JSON.
Do NOT include explanations before or after the JSON.
Do NOT wrap the JSON in Markdown.
Do NOT use JSON code fences.

Use exactly this JSON structure:

{
  "deck_title": "string",
  "card_count": 10,
  "flashcards": [
    {
      "card_number": 1,
      "difficulty": "Easy",
      "front": "string",
      "back": "string"
    }
  ]
}

Lecture Notes:

{{TEXT}}
